caseNameFull: Green v. White, Superintendent, Missouri Training Center for Men

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until April 25, 1983, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.
